description: 2D sealed box, half water, all walls closed; a piston (B 92 21 from wavemaker.dat, B 110 below the free surface) pushes water in and compresses the air pocket. Isentropic air compressibility in the continuity equation, W 32 2. In longer runs (4 s) the air pressure follows p0 (V0/V)^1.4 to within 0.3 % after start-up. Incompressible air has no solution here.
covers: W 32 2 pjm_corr comp_terms (dp/dt and u.grad p)
